title: introduce-invocation-priority-alignment-matrix-and-token-budget-telemetry
author: Ava Chen
description:
Motivation: We frequently see noisy tenant behavior (bursty low-priority traffic) cause high token consumption and obscure latency regressions for high-priority routes. Existing telemetry shows per-route cost and latency but lacks an explicit alignment between invocation priority, token-budget health, and backlog/backpressure signals. This PR adds an 'Invocation Priority Alignment Matrix' and token-budget telemetry to make tradeoffs visible and enable automated alerting that is priority-aware.

What this PR does: introduces a small service and runtime instrumentation that emits a compact set of metrics and tracing tags used to construct the alignment matrix and enable per-priority alert tuning. Components: 1) runtime instrumentation: add invocation priority tag (invocation.priority) to traces and a short-lived gauge token_budget_ratio per-tenant-route; 2) metrics exporter: Prometheus metrics with labels priority_tier, token_budget_ratio_bucket, backlog_level; 3) priority-alignment service: batch job that computes the matrix (priority vs latency vs budget drift) and writes rollups to the observability store (compact rows for dashboarding); 4) dashboards: new dashboard panels (Priority SLO heatmap, Token Budget Drift timeline, Priority-aware Backpressure explorer); 5) alerting: add token-budget-drift alert with dampening and per-priority thresholds and a fault-tolerant auto-suggest for thresholds based on historical percentiles.

Design notes and tradeoffs: we emit token_budget_ratio as an approximate gauge (0-1) computed from recent quota windows to avoid per-invocation state and reduce cardinality. The matrix is computed from downsampled rollups (per 5m) to keep storage cost bounded. Traces for low-priority invocations are sampled with lower probability but we bias sampling when token_budget_ratio < 0.2 to capture tail behavior.

Backwards compatibility: new metric labels are additive; config defaults preserve current SLOs. The token-budget-drift alert is disabled by default for customers on legacy plans and can be toggled per-tenant in the console.

Testing and validation: unit tests for exporter and matrix builder, integration test using synthetic workload generator (included), and a small loadtest showing Priority SLO heatmap change during induced low-priority burst (results in benchmark/priority-burst-report.md).

Rollout plan: 1) stage in canary (10% of traffic) with feature flag priority_alignment.enabled=false by default; 2) enable telemetry only to collect baseline for 24h; 3) enable dashboard and alert suggestions in monitoring workspace; 4) enable automatic per-tenant suggestions after product review.

Related: references ENG-4821 (priority-aware autoscale), ENG-4310 (token accounting refactor).

review_thread:
Marcelo: Overall this looks good, two asks: (1) can we avoid adding a new expensive metric by reusing existing token counters? (2) add a short note about noise from low-volume tenants.

Ava: Reply - we intentionally use a smoothed token_budget_ratio derived from existing counters to avoid high cardinality; added comment in exporter and linked to telemetry/rollups/README.md. Also added a per-tenant minimum-volume guard in the matrix builder to ignore sub-50-invocation buckets.

Priya: Please ensure alerting dampening defaults are conservative so we don't spam SRE. Also asked for an integration smoke test for console toggle.

Ava: Updated alert defaults to 5m throttle + 3-eval window and added smoke test scripts to scripts/ci/run_priority_integration.sh.

Samir: Noted a possible race in downsampler when computing 5m rollups on cross-shard windows; requested a unit test.

Ava: Added unit test downsampler/rollup_race_test.go and addressed the race by ensuring the builder uses stable sort + deterministic windowing.

Marcelo: Approve after small nits fixed. Priya: Approve. Samir: Approve.

Merge: squash and merge; post-merge tasks scheduled: product review for enabling suggestions and alert doc update.
release_notes: Add Invocation Priority Alignment Matrix and token-budget telemetry: new metrics and dashboards to correlate invocation priority, token-budget drift, and latency. Includes priority-aware alerting with conservative defaults and a rollout plan. No breaking changes.
notes: Deployed to canary on 2026-02-26 behind feature flag. Observability team will review real traffic baselines and force-disable for legacy tenants if needed.
